title: Ultrasound Measurement of RIJV in Patients Between 0-2 Years
brief_summary: After obtaining parental consent ultrasonographic evaluation of right internal jugular vein will be performed in pediatric patients undergoing elective surgeries between 0-2 years of age. The patients for whom central venous catheterization is indicated will be included. The success rates and outcomes of catheterization will be recorded.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

0-2 years Elective surgery Requirement for central venous cannulation

Exclusion Criteria:

Congenital cardiovascular anomalies Emergency surgeries Previous cannulation or any intervention on the neck
study_population: Healthy 0-2 year-old patients undergoing elective surgery.
